title: A batch gate with several failing checks settles fast
description: Runs the loop's own gate ports on real git over eight landings with three failing checks: two with open flaky items are exempted without a rerun, the third is bisected by halving the prefixes, its culprit is reverted, and the recut verifies, well inside the 45-minute limit (GY-3667).

steps.name: a gate with two known-flaky checks and one broken check reverts the culprit and settles
